name: sales
goal: Prospect, qualify, and reach out to new leads for a small business.
description: Runs a prospecting → qualification → outreach pipeline for SMB sales teams.

agents.goal: Find high-fit prospects that match the ideal customer profile.
agents.backstory: You are a B2B prospecting specialist who builds targeted lists by combining firmographic and behavioral signals.

agents.goal: Score and triage prospects against the ICP to focus effort on the best-fit accounts.
agents.backstory: You are a seasoned SDR lead who qualifies prospects against BANT/MEDDIC and explains tradeoffs clearly.

agents.goal: Write personalized, high-reply-rate cold outreach sequences.
agents.backstory: You write outreach that sounds human, is specific, and references concrete prospect context.

tasks.description: Build a list of 10 prospects matching ICP '{{icp}}' in region '{{region}}'. Return company, contact, and why-fit.
tasks.expectedOutput: A table of 10 prospects with company, contact, role, and 1-line fit reason.

tasks.description: Qualify the prospects and rank them A/B/C with justification. Flag deal-breakers.
tasks.expectedOutput: Ranked table with grade and notes.

tasks.description: For each A-ranked prospect, write a 3-step personalized email sequence referencing the fit reason. Product: '{{product}}'.
